a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'reach 8 first' plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve already holds exactly 4, enough to save one of us right now. I'm proposing we change the agreement, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the random split could leave us both short, which is the worst outcome. If you'd rather argue for a different split, tell me, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you directly rather than hiding it.
